_comment: Manual corrections applied by merge_licenses.py on every run. 'exclude' removes a license and prevents it from being re-added; 'overrides' forces field values; 'add' inserts records the pipeline missed. Give a reason for every entry. Audit source: Licensing Board voting minutes (see scraper/scrape/data/voting_minutes_pdfs).
